curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How does a woman altered by childhood trauma fit into the life of a firefighter clinging to a decade-old reunion?
curatedMovie.description: After a childhood accident leaves her with a metal plate in her head, a woman’s strange journey brings her to a firefighter reunited with his son.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Unsettling, intense horror drama with an off-kilter atmosphere and a deliberately disorienting sense of encounter.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its horror-drama frame and unusual encounter make room for a tense, emotionally charged watch that resists easy expectations.
